ATX 3.1 Support
Compliant with ATX 3.1 to fully support a peak power 1.5 times higher than the rated maximum wattage, this unit is ideal for use with the 40 series GPUs.*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
Embossed Cable
An embossed cable texture provides a softer and overall improved grip with a pleasing aesthetic.​
Quiet HDB Fan
A hydrodynamic bearing fan delivers long-lasting quiet and effective cooling.​*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
Certified Efficiency
The MWE Bronze V3 is certified to achieve more than 85% efficiency at typical loads.​​*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
High Temperature Resilience
A 40°C operating temperature allows for pushing your machine to the limits.​*All performance stats confirmed in 25°C ambient temperature testing.
